jobs_results.title: Test Automation Specialist
jobs_results.description:
We are seeking a skilled Test Automation Engineer to join our dynamic team. As a Test Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and executing automated tests to ensure the quality and reliability of our software products. This role will primarily focus on performance testing
• *Key Responsibilities:**

- Develop and implement automated test scripts for performance testing.

- Utilize tools such as SoapUI, Postman, JMeter, Selenium (for Java background), or Cypress

(for JavaScript background) to conduct automated testing.

- Collaborate closely with development teams to support the creation of Acceptance Criteria and

ensure alignment with testing objectives.

- Demonstrate proficiency in database concepts and possess SQL skills to validate data integrity

during testing processes.

- Leverage Java background to enhance test automation frameworks and contribute to codebase

improvements.

- Optionally, utilize experience with development in Java... knowledge of OpenShift, and familiarity

with microservices architecture to provide additional support and insights.
• *Qualifications:**

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

- Proven experience in test automation with a focus on performance testing.

- Proficiency in using tools such as SoapUI, Postman, JMeter, Selenium and Cypress.

- Strong understanding of Acceptance Criteria and ability to translate them into automated test

scenarios.

- Solid knowledge of databases and ability to write and execute SQL queries for testing purposes.

- Experience with Java programming is required; familiarity with additional languages is a plus.

- Optional experience in development with Java, working with OpenShift, and understanding of

microservices architecture is desirable.
• *Skills and Abilities:**

- Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively within cross-functional teams.

- Ability to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.

- Self-motivated with a passion for quality assurance and continuous improvement.

If you are a dedicated Test Automation Engineer with a strong background in performance testing, along with proficiency in relevant tools and technologies, we encourage you to apply and be part of our innovative team

jobs_results.title: Test Automation Engineer
jobs_results.description:
¿Buscas un nuevo reto profesional?, ¿te gustaría especializarte en el área de automatización de pruebas? Sigue leyendo, esto te interesa.

En NTT DATA desarrollamos ecosistemas a través de tecnologías de vanguardia, potenciando nuestra creatividad, respetando la diversidad y apostando por una cultura inclusiva. Contamos con diferentes iniciativas que ayudan a potenciar nuestro "diversity mindset".

Actualmente estamos ampliando nuestro equipo del área de calidad, y buscamos desarrollares/as Java y/o Python con inquietud en el campo de pruebas automatizadas; ¿te apetece aceptar el desafío y adentrarte en el mundo del testing? Contamos con un equipo especializado y con referentes en este sector con los que tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar mano a mano y evolucionar profesionalmente.

Por ello, si cuentas con un background tecnológico sólido, conoces los frameworks y herramientas de automatización del mercado y quieres difundir o empaparte de las mejores prácticas de control de calidad... al mismo tiempo que ofreces productos que permiten a nuestros clientes gozar de una experiencia diferencial… ¡Estás ante la oportunidad que estabas buscando!

Nuestro crecimiento no entiende de límites y es por ello por lo que nos gustaría incorporar perfiles que nos permitan garantizar el funcionamiento exitoso de nuestras aplicaciones Back-end y Front-end, automatizando el procesos de prueba mediante el uso de enfoques de prueba modernos y herramientas de automatización.

Queremos conocerte y que nos conozcas, acercarte los proyectos con cobertura global en los que nos encontramos trabajando y que te brindarán tantas oportunidades de crecimiento como te propongas. ¡Que dedicarte a lo que realmente te apasiona sea tu mejor proyecto!

¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades?
• Diseñar y desarrollar soluciones automatizadas para la aplicación web en un entorno ágil y multifuncional.
• Diseñar y desarrollar soluciones automatizadas para el backend (APIs, microservicios) en un entorno ágil y multifuncional.
• Trabajar en un marco metodológico de pruebas siguiendo BDD para respaldar las necesidades actuales para entregar un producto de calidad.
• Ejecutar y supervisar el conjunto de pruebas y abordar los problemas detectados.
• Mejorar continuamente el conjunto de pruebas y aumentar la cobertura.
• Trabajar con los diferentes miembros de los equipos para optimizar la calidad de la automatización de pruebas.
• Supervisión cruzada del código con sus compañeros.
• Compartir y prestar apoyo a otros miembros del equipo de ingenieros de automatización de control de calidad con el desarrollo de pruebas.
• Trabajar con DevOps para sugerir mejoras en los procesos y el ciclo de integración continua de Jenkins/Bamboo.

¿Cuáles son los requisitos?
• Mínimo 2 años de experiencia trabajando con Java u otro lenguaje OOP.
• Valorable experiencia en pruebas de API (métodos HTTP, cómo funciona la funcionalidad de inicio de sesión en el nivel de API).
• Experiencia en Automatización de Pruebas (Localizadores, patrones de diseño, frameworks, pageobject, anotaciones).
• Experiencia con tecnologías de automatización de pruebas como TestNG, JUnit, Selenium WebDriver, Katalon, Appium, Cypress.
• Experiencia en la automatización de procesos de construcción, implementaciones de aplicaciones y sistemas de integración continua como Jenkins/Bamboo.
• Conocimientos de POO (Herencia, polimorfismo, encapsulación, abstracción).
• Conocimiento de los fundamentos de las pruebas (tipos de pruebas, niveles, ciclo de vida de errores).
• Conocimiento de Herramientas (Jenkins, Bamboo, TestRail, Jira, Postman, etc.).
• Conocimiento/comprensión SDLC (Cascada, Agile/Scrum, Kanban).
• Persona motivada y orientada a los detalles con sólidas habilidades analíticas y de investigación.
• Deseable: habilidades avanzadas de comunicación escrita y verbal en inglés.

Además, ¿qué ofrecemos?
• Plan de carrera personalizado.
• Beneficios sociales.
• Flexibilidad horaria.
• Modelo híbrido de trabajo, a elegir.
• Acceso al programa de certificaciones oficiales.
• Incorporación a una comunidad de profesionales altamente cualificados.

¡NTT DATA es tu sitio! Porque hemos obtenido en España, por 9º año consecutivo, la certificación Top Employer, que nos reconoce como una de las mejores empresas en las que trabajar, gracias a nuestro compromiso por el talento. Únete a un equipo que apuesta por el desarrollo integral de sus profesionales, elige el modelo de trabajo que mejor se adapte a ti, y colabora en un entorno diverso, donde cada persona tiene su propia singularidad

jobs_results.title: QA Automation (100% remoto - España)
jobs_results.description:
Desde la división de IT de Walters People estamos ayudando a uno de nuestros clientes finales, del sector automotriz, en la búsqueda de un Quality Assurance con al menos 3-4 años de experiencia en testing automatizado

Nuestro cliente quiere incrementar el equipo tecnológico con la incorporación de un Quality Assurance en sus oficinas de Madrid con flexibilidad de teletrabajo

Entre sus funciones estará:
• Aumentar la calidad y de la automatización de pruebas.
• Desarrollar y ejecutar planes de prueba, casos de prueba y scripts de prueba
• Colaborar con equipos multifuncionales, incluidos desarrolladores, arquitectos y gestión de programa
• Diseñar y mantener marcos de automatización de pruebas, optimizando procesos de prueba y aumentando la eficiencia.
• Probar dentro de entornos en la nube (AWS, Azure)
• Utilizar herramientas estándar para la automatización de pruebas y la gestión de pruebas para agilizar los esfuerzos de prueba.
• Facilitar la comunicación entre equipos de pruebas... equipos de desarrollo, profesionales de datos y otros interesados para garantizar pruebas exitosas

Requisitos:
• Experiencia en testing automatizado.
• Experiencia en AWS y Azure
• Nivel de inglés alto
• Grado en Ingeniería Informática o equivalente

Ofrecen:
• Incorporación directa al equipo del cliente con contrato indefinido desde el primer momento.
• Salario basado fijo competitivo + variable
• 30 días de vacaciones
• Flexibilidad horaria y de teletrabajo
• desarrollo y plan de carrera
• beneficios

Si estás interesado en un cambio no dudes en inscribirte, o mandarme tu CV a Maite.gonzalez@walterspeople.com

jobs_results.title: Test Automation Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Don’t guess it – test it!

Are you driven by high quality standards and do you want to take responsibility? We are looking for a Test Automation Software Engineer (Hybrid based in Barcelona, Spain) to become part of our self-organized Scrum team and help us to further develop and improve our solutions. Next to that, being successful is about being part of our mission to shape and influence thousands of businesses and drivers around the world – making mobility more accessible, smarter and safer.

Join us and become our team internal gatekeeper for a bug-free and joyful user experience. Support us in designing and engineering new end-to-end scenarios, automate manual processes and lead us to a world where we as a team and company are able to release quicker and with much higher quality than ever before.

Here’s a little taste of your challenge:
• Planning, execution, analysis and documentation of software tests.
• Creation of test plans and test scenarios as well as analysis of... requirements and test data.
• Test automation.
• Analyzing and improving processes for sustainable quality assurance.

Who are you?

There is no set route to become Test Automation Software Engineer in Bridgestone Mobility Solutions. But to be successful in this role, this is the kind of profile we have in mind:
• You have a sound knowledge of test methods, test processes and test management and experience in creating test concepts.
• Good communication skills, holistic and systemic thinking, goal-oriented, versatile problem-solving skills, and open mind.
• You bring experience in test automation.
• You have experience in Java (mandatory), Rest-assured, Cucumber or Selenium.
• Fluency in English (written and spoken). Notions of Spanish is mandatory.
• You have a desire to be actively involved in our international QA guild.
• A desire to work as part of an international organization and cooperate with other test engineers, software engineers, system engineers, architects, product owners and external partners across multiple locations.
• Desirable to have Drivers license.

What can you expect?
• An adventure in software product development within a rapidly growing business unit of a globally renowned brand and various opportunities for your professional development.
• Being part of a team of expert developers and contribute in applying high quality standards.
• Brilliant minds. Learn from your colleagues – pioneers and experts who are changing the world.
• Different cultures. Our colleagues come from all over the world, with 55 nationalities and counting.

Let’s not forget the good stuff:
• Competitive salary.
• 500 euros gross to set up your home office.
• Chance to work abroad for 40 working days per year.
• Birthday off and volunteering time off.
• Additional health and dental insurance (Including children and partners).
• 100% employer funded pension scheme.
• Lunch or childcare vouchers.
• Free English and Spanish lessons.
• Employee Assistance Program.
• Flexible working model.
• Plenty of formal training for new joiners + access to LinkedIn Learning.
• Once you have earned the merits to warrant it, there will be opportunity to attend trainings and conferences on company budget.
• Annual performance reviews, personal development plans, and as much feedback as you want and can handle through regular 1:1 meeting.

Who are we?

We are Bridgestone Mobility Solutions, and we are on a mission to move the world towards a sustainable future using data-driven mobility.

The high-value products and services we develop for fleets, original equipment manufacturers and governments make travel smoother, reduce congestion, increase accessibility, improve vehicle and road safety and cut carbon emissions.

Bridgestone Mobility Solutions is a Business Unit of the Bridgestone Corporation, a global leader in tyres and rubber, present in Europe, the Americas, Australia and Africa.

Webfleet is one of our lines of business within Bridgestone Mobility Solutions. A globally trusted fleet management solution, Webfleet analyses live data from hundreds of thousands of vehicles to help businesses boost fleet productivity, cut costs and increase safety.

Webfleet is used by more than 50,000 customers worldwide, providing them with the industry’s largest support network and the widest range of dedicated applications and integration tools.

For further information, please visit webfleet.com. Follow us on Twitter @WebfleetNews. For more information about Bridgestone in EMIA, please visit www.bridgestone-emia.com and Bridgestone newsroom.

Want to join us? 

If that’s a yes, then please apply to say hi. Complete the online form and attachments in English, please.

Do note that online technical evaluation and pre-employment screening are part of the selection process.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status

jobs_results.title: QA Automation Engineer
jobs_results.description:
As a QA Automation Engineer, you will work in focused and dynamic team delivering value through web applications and will be responsible for automation testing process, assuring standard levels of quality to all our channel platforms along with providing assistance to manual testing. You will be part of the IT Marketing & Sales Omnichannel Engagement team and your daily tech stack will be composed by languages and platforms such as Java, Selenium, RestaAssured and Jenkins, among others.

Tasks and responsibilities

• Work with the scrum team to identify testing needs and opportunities.

• Work with the team in developing a QA automation testing strategy for each product, determining the appropriate balance of manual and automated tests, as well as the types of tests.

• Create manual test plans, test cases, and test scripts.

• Execute and report on the full testing suite of both manual and automated tests.

Requirements

• Bachelor and/or master’s degree in Computer Science or... comparable.

• At least 3 years of experience in automation testing (Experience on Selenium along with Java or Python) for Front end (web) and backend

• Familiarity with tech stack of the following tools: Java, Selenium or Cucumber, OkHttp / RestAssured, SpringBoot, Gradle, Jenkins, BrowserStack

• Knowledge in QA Methodology (Regression and Smoke testing), in test case designing, identifying test data needs, and set up, testing techniques and test optimization methods.

• Experience using source control systems such as Github and having knowledge of best practices for agile testing on a Scrum team is a plus

• Advanced level of English

#IamBoehringerIngelheim because…

We are continuously working to design the best experience for you. Here are some examples of how we will take care of you:

• Flexible working conditions

• Life and accident insurance

• Health insurance at a competitive price

• Investment in your learning and development

• Gym membership discounts

If you have read this far, what are you waiting for to apply? We want to know more about you!

Our Company

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies that improve the lives of both humans and animals. Founded in 1885 and family-owned ever since, Boehringer Ingelheim takes a long-term perspective. Now, we are powered by 52,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture. We believe that if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve.

Why Boehringer Ingelheim?

With us, you can grow, collaborate, innovate and improve lives.

We offer challenging work in a respectful and friendly global working environment surrounded by a world of innovation driven mindsets and practices. In addition, learning and development for all employees is key, because your growth is our growth.

Boehringer Ingelheim is an equal opportunity global employer who takes pride in maintaining a diverse and inclusive culture. We embrace diversity of perspectives and strive for an inclusive environment, which benefits our employees, patients and communities.

Want to learn more? visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

jobs_results.title: Test Automation Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Omada is a fast-growing global cybersecurity software company with locations across the world and headquartered in Copenhagen Denmark. We are a Gartner Magic Quadrant leader in Identity Governance and Administration with one of the most advanced SaaS platforms in the industry. Our vision is to secure the world s identities. Omada s growth is backed by some of the best private equity funds in the world who are investing in technology and looking to expand Omada s overall CTPO organization.

We are looking for a skilled Test Automation Developer to join our scrum team where you get to develop tests scenarios and test scripts for new features of our IT security product.

Our office in Alicante is providing attractive working conditions for our employees and we are ready for the many new colleagues that we will be hiring in the coming months. You will be working closely together with our developers in Poland and Denmark via fully integrated scrum teams and get a high amount of... responsibility in the further development of our product.

In your role as Test Automation Developer you will

Extend and improve the existing UI and inthe the tegration test framework and introduce new ones if necessary.

Analyze documentation cooperate with scrum team to understand business requirements and create testable stories and requirements.

Estimate time required for performing test activities.

Create test scenarios and test cases with a focus on automation.

Record defects using bug tracking software investigate and analyze each problem track status of defect and verify its resolution during the testing life cycle.

Execute on automated tests investigate and analyze results.

Perform peer code reviews and do peer programming sessions.

Participate in all SCRUM ceremonies e.g. the sprint planning session where plans are made with the entire team and the PO and the end of sprint demonstrations where the latest innovations are shared with the larger team.

Be responsible for the quality working closely together with scrum team members securing a high quality when we release new features.

You have

You have at least 3 - 5 years of experience with test automation.

You have a good eye for details and you are ambitious and passionate about test and technologies.

You can collaborate with developers to understand how the development changes affect ongoing automation efforts.

Higher IT education such as graduate or master

Experience with the following C# and .NET

Experience with Selenium WebDriver or similar UI action simulation tools

Knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server

Hands on experience with Test automation and implementation of testing tools

Experience with Microsoft Test Manager Azure DevOps

Advanced experience with test runners like NUnit xUnit MSTest or similar

We Offer

Omada is an incredible place to work and develop your career and technical skills. We have a strong focus on our people and our core values including Teamwork Being Ambitious Always Delivering Value Constant Care.

These values are also reflected in the relationship with our employees and the way we live every day.

We want our employees to be able to have a great career at Omada and offer a modern flexible working model where they will be able to work more days remotely. We anticipate 2 days of work from the office in Alicante per week. We also provide great benefits and rewards that you would expect from a market leading global software company.

Some of the Benefits we offer

Training budget

Access to LinkedIn Learning

The opportunity to work with passionate competent people experts within their field

Informal and agile organization with a flat structure

C#, .NET, Selenium, SQL Server

jobs_results.title: QA Automation Engineer. SDET. Python. Java. Ingles
jobs_results.description:
En GRUPO NS buscamos profesionales QA con experiencia de 4-5 años contrastada en Automatización de Pruebas, en Python y/o Java, para distintos proyectos de primer nivel, en modalidad remota.

Grupo NS es una empresa que valora tanto el perfil tecnológico profesional de sus empleados como el interés y la aptitud que muestran a la hora de desarrollar nuevos proyectos.

Por ello, requerimos personas constantes, con ganas de evolucionar y aprender.

Requisitos mínimos

Skills
• Experiencia de al menos 4 años en: Programación de software (Python, Java, .NET...) Metodología ágil (Scrum, Kanban) Pruebas de API (Postman, Newman...) Automatización de pruebas funcionales (Selenium) Metodologías BDD (Gherkin, Cucumber)
• Revisar historias de usuario y evaluarlas. Elaborar estrategias de test y calidad. Elaborar el plan de pruebas e identificar los casos de prueba a automatizar. Realizar pruebas manuales, implementar los scripts de automatización basados en las metodologías y herramientas... seleccionadas y ejecutarlos. Asegurar el modelo de pruebas ágiles en la célula del equipo Scrum. Proporcionar soporte de pruebas unitarias a los desarrolladores. Gestionar el aprovisionamiento de requisitos de prueba. Gestionar los defectos. Coordinar las pruebas con otros equipos, rendimiento, seguridad...
• Nivel avanzado y fluido en inglés, C1

Se Valorará
• Certificación ISTQB
